recognize_zh: CD68 在右側病灶的內襯細胞與腔內脫落細胞團呈強陽性（顆粒狀），左側白髓淋巴球為陰性；病灶細胞帶有組織球標記，這是 littoral cell angioma 的特徵之一。
features: Strong granular cytoplasmic CD68 staining in lesional lining cells (right)
Cluster of large, intensely CD68-positive desquamated cells within a blood-filled lumen
Adjacent white pulp lymphoid tissue (left) is CD68-negative except for rare histiocytes
Lesional area shows anastomosing channels with plump positive cells
Blood-filled cystic space in upper field
describe_en: CD68 immunostain of spleen shows strong granular cytoplasmic staining of the cells lining the vascular channels of the lesion, as well as a cluster of large, intensely positive cells shed into a blood-filled lumen. The adjacent white pulp is essentially negative. Expression of the histiocytic marker CD68 in the lining cells supports the dual endothelial-histiocytic phenotype of littoral cell angioma.

ddx.vs: Hemangioma lining cells are CD31+/CD34+ but lack CD68 and CD163 expression.
HLH shows scattered CD68+ hemophagocytic macrophages in cords and sinuses without a mass-forming vascular lesion lined by CD68+ cells.
LCH cells are CD1a+/langerin+/S100+ with grooved nuclei and form infiltrates rather than lining vascular channels.
